Pester closure scope required capturing the fixture packet scriptblock; test Git plumbing had emitted a CLR task result into its return stream. Corrected each, then 44 and 55 focused cases passed. Review added a genuine fast-forward CAS case, discovery reorder and aggregate/deadline corrections; final combined gate passed 225. Earlier diagnostics are preserved and not presented as green.

protocol.refUpdate: Exact expected-old server comparison; no force fallback or application-level retry

remainingGates: Installed gh 2.46.0 has no attestation command. Provision independently pinned compatible verifier/root/bundle and validate real signed positive/negative bundles; fixture certificates are not cryptographic proof.
Audited reusable sealer and trusted policy/custody provisioning remain absent; do not sign producer-controlled digests without independent sealing.

Actual GitHub smart-HTTP existing-object compatibility, identity/permissions, branch/ruleset rejection, expected-old race and lost-ack behavior need separately authorized bounded live tests. Local Git is not hosted proof.
Repository-ID-restricted writer credential and supported operational policy/consumer mapping must be separately reviewed/provisioned. Metadata observations are not atomic with a GitHub write.

Unresolved/Consumed/global custody blocks cannot be cleared by a new transaction. External history, full custody rollback or hostile same-user store replacement require separate audited intervention; no override/abandonment mechanism is supplied.

This writer remains source-only, not included in the accepted native package or connected to a workflow. Historical fresh human administrator workflow/collector-recovery and other Goal 6 release gates remain open.
